relations.subject: Erich Frauwallner
relations.evidence: enrolled at Vienna University in the winter term of 1918/1919. Frauwallner studied Classical Philology and took courses in Indology and Iranian Studies. His doctoral thesis... was approved in 1921.

relations.subject: Erich Frauwallner
relations.evidence: in 1928 he received the venia legendi for Indology... In addition to teaching at the secondary school he taught until 1938 as a sessional instructor at Vienna University.

relations.subject: Erich Frauwallner
relations.evidence: Frauwallner was appointed professor extraordinarius of Indology and Iranian Studies in August 1939... On June 6, 1945, he was dismissed from the University

relations.subject: Erich Frauwallner
relations.evidence: in 1955 he was again appointed professor extraordinarius.

relations.subject: Erich Frauwallner
relations.object: Wiener Zeitschrift für die Kunde Süd- und Ostasiens
relations.evidence: in 1957 he founded the influential Wiener Zeitschrift für die Kunde Süd- und Ostasiens.

relations.subject: Erich Frauwallner
relations.evidence: Appointed full professor at the newly founded Institute of Indology that opened March 21, 1960, he retired in 1963.

relations.subject: Karin Preisendanz
relations.evidence: the "Preface" by Karin Preisendanz and Eli Franco in Die Philosophie des Buddhismus to be soon reprinted by the Akademie Verlag, Berlin. I gratefully acknowledge having received an almost completed manuscript of this preface at the end of 2006

relations.subject: Gelong Lodrö Sangpo
relations.evidence: He became one of the co-founders, in 1996, of the Nitartha Institute for the transmission of Buddhist learning and practice

relations.subject: Gelong Lodrö Sangpo
relations.evidence: is a senior teacher at the Vidyadhara Institute, the monastic college (shedra) of Gampo Abbey.

relations.subject: Gelong Lodrö Sangpo
